labels.title: Solar return {year}
labels.moment_text: The Sun returns to its birth position — {sun} — at **{local}** local time ({tz}).
labels.adjacent_year: The nearest return falls in an adjacent calendar year.
labels.planets_in_houses: Planets of the year by house
labels.aspects_natal_none: No exact aspects within the orb.
labels.days_intro: Each day lasts exactly 24 hours from the moment of the solar return. The twelve days before close the old year; the twelve after open the new one. Each day corresponds to one house.
labels.method_text: Swiss Ephemeris (Moshier), tropical zodiac, house system: {hs}. Birth time converted to UTC with the IANA time-zone history. Astrology here is a language for reflection, not a scientific forecast.
labels.degrees_intro: In Russian-language astrology certain degrees of the signs are considered special. A royal degree traditionally strengthens and supports a planet; a destructive degree marks a vulnerable spot that needs awareness. These are symbolic accents, not verdicts.
labels.degrees_none: No point falls on a royal or destructive degree.
labels.relocation: Where to meet the solar return
labels.relocation_intro: The moment of the solar return is the same everywhere on Earth, but houses and angles depend on the place. The comparison shows how the chart of the year changes from city to city.
labels.scan: Longitudes at latitude {lat}° where the SR Sun is in house {house}
labels.scan_none: At this latitude the SR Sun never falls in house {house}.
labels.relocation_how: How to choose: start from your intention for the year. The Sun house shows the main arena, the Ascendant the overall tone, and planets within 5° of an angle sound stronger. Weigh the options against the keys of the year and where you can really travel.
labels.year_by_area_intro: Each solar-return house falls on one of your natal houses: the theme of the year is lived through that area of your life.
labels.lunations: New and full moons in these days
labels.launch: Recommendation: where to meet the solar return
labels.launch_home: At home ({name}) the SR Sun is in house {house}.
labels.launch_nearest: Nearest point where this holds: {lat}, {lon} — about {km} km from home.
labels.launch_none: No such point within {km} km. Widen the radius or choose another house.
labels.launch_already: The goal already holds at home — no need to travel.
labels.launch_sun_asc: Sun exactly on the Ascendant along the same latitude: longitude {lon} (about {km} km).
labels.launch_boundary: Zone boundary along the same latitude: from longitude {lon} (about {km} km).
labels.launch_angles: Angles at the recommended point: ASC {asc}, MC {mc}.
labels.launch_angles_ok: No royal or destructive degrees on the angles.
labels.launch_plan_text: Arrive the day before and stay the night at the chosen place, so you are surely there at the minute of the return. At the moment itself — a quiet pause, simply presence. The next 2–3 days you can stay there or make day trips into the zone and return home in the evening.
labels.diary_intro: A solar return is read, not wished for. These 24 days are for observing and noting what really happens: events, meetings, sensations, thoughts, ideas, dreams. Each day stands for its house. Even a small thing is a signal.
labels.diary_how_closing: 12 days before (closing): how the outgoing year completes each house. Houses run from 12 to 1.
labels.diary_how_opening: 12 days after (opening): the tone each area will carry all year. Houses run from 1 to 12.
labels.diary_bounds: Day boundaries: from {time} to {time} the next day. Write in the evening or the next morning before {time}.
labels.f_close: Conclusion — how this area is closing
labels.f_open: Conclusion — how this area opens for the year
labels.goal_close: Closing last year's goal: how the last day of house 1 was lived, who you have become, how the main theme of the past year ended.
labels.goal_open: Opening the new year's goal: after the pause, the first events, people and words unfold the goal of the year. Watch especially closely.
labels.zero: Zero degree — the switch of the year's goal
labels.zero_text: The most important moment of the cycle. The day before, last year's goal completes. At the minute of the return the Sun comes back to its point, and around that instant there is a short switching pause, about half an hour either side: one goal has closed, the new one has not unfolded yet. After the pause, life starts to show the goal of the new year.
labels.zero_f1: How last year's goal closed (the evening before)
labels.zero_f3: First events, people, words, thoughts after the pause
labels.zero_f4: A sense of the goal of the year
checklist_items: Choose where to meet the return and book a night there the day before
Set an alarm so you are calmly in place by the minute of the return
Print or open the observation diary

signs.name: Aries
signs.asc: A year of beginnings and direct action. You come across as bolder and more decisive, and much will start from scratch.
signs.shadow: haste, conflict, abandoning what you began
signs.helps: one main goal and physical activity to let off steam

signs.name: Taurus
signs.asc: A year of stability, body and resources. Money, comfort, beauty and tangible things come first.
signs.light: reliability, enjoyment of life, growing income
signs.helps: a slow rhythm, care for the body, a clear budget

signs.name: Gemini
signs.asc: A year of communication, learning and movement. Lots of conversations, messages, trips and new acquaintances.
signs.helps: writing ideas down and finishing at least one

signs.name: Cancer
signs.asc: A year of home, family and feelings. Where and with whom you live, and how safe you feel, matter most.
signs.shadow: touchiness, withdrawal, living in the past
signs.helps: a cosy space and honest talks with loved ones

signs.name: Leo
signs.asc: A year of self-expression and visibility. You want to create, be seen and lead.
signs.helps: a creative project that is a joy in itself

signs.name: Virgo
signs.asc: A year of order, health and craft. Time to set up routines, systems and skills.
signs.helps: small daily steps and kindness to yourself

signs.name: Libra
signs.asc: A year of relationships and balance. Partnership, agreements and beauty come to the fore.
signs.helps: naming your own wishes honestly in relationships

signs.name: Scorpio
signs.asc: A year of depth and transformation. Hidden things surface; relationships and resources are tested.
signs.light: power, passion, release of the old
signs.helps: honesty with yourself and body work

signs.name: Sagittarius
signs.asc: A year of widening horizons. Travel, study, the search for meaning and new opportunities.
signs.helps: a big goal broken into concrete steps

signs.name: Capricorn
signs.asc: A year of responsibility and building. Career, status and long-term goals need discipline.
signs.helps: a plan for the year and regular guilt-free rest

signs.name: Aquarius
signs.asc: A year of freedom and change. New ideas, friends, communities and unexpected turns.
signs.shadow: detachment, rebellion for its own sake
signs.helps: a community of interest and room to experiment

signs.name: Pisces
signs.asc: A year of intuition and inner life. Sensitivity grows; inspiration, compassion and rest matter.
signs.helps: creativity, water, sleep and clear boundaries

sun.name: Sun
sun.principle: vitality and the main task of the year

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.principle: structure, responsibility and the test of time

houses.closing: Look back on the year: who you were and what you learned.
houses.opening: The most important day of the year: joy, pleasant people, no negativity.
houses.helps: caring for your body and appearance
houses.observe: wellbeing, appearance, first reactions, initiative, everything about yourself

houses.closing: Put your finances in order and see what truly matters.
houses.opening: Treat yourself and your body; don't risk money.
houses.helps: a clear budget and respect for your work
houses.observe: money, purchases, belongings, food, a sense of support or lack, values

houses.sphere: communication, learning, close circle, short trips
houses.closing: Finish open conversations and sum up what you learned.
houses.opening: Notice which people, words and signs come to you; start learning.
houses.helps: a course, writing or a blog
houses.observe: conversations, messages, news, short trips, learning, neighbours, siblings

houses.closing: Call your parents, remember your ancestors, tidy your home.
houses.opening: Think about where and how you want to live; thank your family line.
houses.helps: a cosy home and time with family
houses.observe: home, parents, family, housing, the past, the sense of a nest

houses.sphere: love, creativity, children, joy and play
houses.closing: Remember what brought you joy; give thanks for love.
houses.opening: A celebration, a date, creativity — those who love you will show it.
houses.observe: joy, falling in love, children, play, hobbies, creativity, risk

houses.sphere: health, work, routine, caring for others
houses.closing: Look at how you cared for your body; drop one bad habit.
houses.opening: Move a lot and set up a healthy routine.
houses.observe: body and health, routine, habits, order, duties, pets

houses.closing: See who truly stood by you; have an honest talk with someone close.
houses.opening: Watch who is who; avoid conflicts.
houses.observe: partner, alliances, contracts, one-to-one meetings, open disputes

houses.sphere: crises and change, shared resources, deep transformation
houses.closing: Let go of what has run its course; forgive.
houses.opening: A day for extra care: rest, solitude, nothing risky.
houses.observe: shared and other people's money, debts, intimacy, fears, strong emotions, change

houses.closing: What did the year teach you; plan trips and study.
houses.opening: A good day for important signatures and meeting mentors.
houses.observe: travel, abroad, study, law, faith, big meanings

houses.closing: Sum up your work and take a step toward your calling.
houses.opening: Put yourself forward and send out offers: the day shows the work of the year.

houses.closing: Recall the year's dreams; thank your friends.
houses.opening: Friends, plans, dreams — help others, but don't decide for them.
houses.helps: a community and a bold dream
houses.observe: friends, like-minded people, plans, hopes, patrons, social media

houses.sphere: solitude, rest, inner life, letting go
houses.closing: Solitude, summing up the year, reflecting on successes and mistakes.
houses.opening: Silence, dreams, cleansing, gratitude for the road travelled.
houses.observe: solitude, dreams, intuition, endings, what happens behind the scenes

sun_house: The main arena of the year is you. A year of a personal fresh start: a new image, new decisions, more initiative.
The main arena of the year is money and values. Time to strengthen income, resources and self-worth.
The main arena of the year is communication and learning. Many contacts, trips, texts and new skills.
The main arena of the year is home and family: a move, renovation, parents or finding your roots.
The main arena of the year is love and creativity. A year of romance, children, hobbies and joy.
The main arena of the year is work and health. Time to set up routines, skills and daily life.
The main arena of the year is partnership. Relationships, marriage, alliances and contracts come first.
The main arena of the year is deep change: crises, shared money, renewal through letting go.
The main arena of the year is widening horizons: travel, study, abroad and the search for meaning.
The main arena of the year is career. Goals, status and recognition need attention and bring results.
The main arena of the year is friends and plans: communities, like-minded people and bold dreams.
The main arena of the year is inner life. A year of preparation, solitude and quiet inner change.
moon_house: Feelings are on show: mood strongly shapes decisions, so take good care of yourself.
Emotional calm depends on money and comfort; you long for stability.
Emotions flow through communication: talks, messages and trips matter.
The heart turns to home and family; changes at home are possible.
The heart is open to love, creativity and children; you crave joy.
Feelings are tied to work and health; a gentle routine is needed.
A partner matters emotionally; relationships become a mirror.
Deep feelings and inner change; don't keep everything inside.
The soul asks for space: travel, study, new meaning.
Feelings are tied to work and reputation; career changes are possible.
Friends and community are your emotional support.
A need for solitude and rest; intuition grows stronger.

conjunction.name: conjunction
conjunction.tone: {a} and {b} merge: the theme sounds bright and concentrated
conjunction.helps: consciously direct this concentrated force into one pursuit

sextile.name: sextile
sextile.tone: {a} and {b} offer an easy opportunity, if you take it
sextile.helps: take the first step — the opportunity will not act on its own

square.name: square
square.tone: {a} and {b} are in a tension that pushes you to act
square.helps: turn the tension into concrete action, not argument

trine.name: trine
trine.tone: {a} and {b} work together, giving smooth support
trine.helps: don't coast: use the support for something important

opposition.name: opposition
opposition.tone: {a} and {b} face each other: balance is needed, often through other people
opposition.helps: seek balance and listen to the other side

templates.stellium_text: Several planets gather in the area of {sphere}. This will be one of the main themes of the year.
templates.angular_text: {principle} — this force will be especially visible in the area of {sphere}.
templates.retro_text: The theme of {principle} returns from the past: a time to review, finish, and revisit old people and ideas.
templates.natal_key: Solar-return Sun and Moon in the natal houses
templates.natal_text: The solar-return Sun falls in your natal house {sun} ({sun_sphere}), the Moon in natal house {moon} ({moon_sphere}). The year is lived through these areas of your life.
templates.meeting: An hour before the return, find a quiet place and put your phone away. Recall the past year with gratitude and write down what you want to let go of. At the minute of the return, say one intention for the year to yourself — one sentence, in the present tense. Then spend time with people you love.
templates.journal: Each evening, briefly note the day's events, how your body felt and what stood out. Reread the notes after the 24 days and before your next solar return to see what proved true for you and what did not.
templates.footer: Made with the free Solar Return skill by AstroEmpathy — astroempathy.org
templates.retro_helps: finish what you started rather than rushing into the new

degree_text.royal: {point} on a royal degree ({deg}th degree of {sign}): this force is traditionally supported and may bring recognition.
degree_text.destructive: {point} on a destructive degree ({deg}th degree of {sign}): this theme needs care and awareness.
